chapter: Porgy and Bess and Varsity Show
title: Busby Berkeley's slide finale and the back injury
summary: Buck wrote Shining My Shoes; Berkeley devised the pedestal ride on a track, which an operator pushed too fast, throwing Bubbles and sending him to Cedars of Lebanon with a back injury.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Was that what you two thought of?
How about the sliding down to the piano?
That was George, -- what am I thinking of -- Busby Berkeley. He put that finale on -- Busby Berkeley.
Yeah, uh-huh and he put that in there. That's his idea.
Was it a difficult thing to do?

difficult, the only thing about it was the guy did it wrong. The guy put the juice on it, by switching -- increased the juice on it, you know, decrease and increase, and pushed it around, he started off and he pushed it around too fast and threw me off of it. I fell all the way down that thing, down on the floor. I had to lay off, crippled me, had to go to the hospital, had to bandage me up. Stayed in the hospital about four or five days.
Did you sprain an ankle or something?
That was the first time you did it.
Yeah -- first or second time. I was in Cedars Lebanon Hospital on that account.
Were there any other difficulties other than that one?
Nope. That's the only one I had.
So that device you were sitting on was motorized.
Oh, yeah, I come down on a pedestal that rolled on a track, you know, and that's what brought me down.
